args.summary: checkout-api started failing health checks after the release of v2.3.1 to production, with an elevated error rate (~18%) across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Remediation: rolled checkout-api back to the most recent known-healthy production release, which is v2.2.9 in all production regions (v2.2.9 was the last previously healthy production version; the more recent v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417 and could not be used). Rollback completed successfully; service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 health-check failures before re-attempting that release, and apply a fixed, non-quarantined version.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to healthy release
